title: Explicit bounded outcome
requirement: WHEN a declared execution profile cannot perform its next transition within its runtime bounds, the interpreter SHALL publish the bound outcome defined by that profile.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Finite recursive attempt
scenarios.when: An otherwise valid recursive run reaches its fuel limit after making progress.
scenarios.then: The result is Exhausted(Fuel), with consumed work reported separately from an application return. Under sherlock-k-a/1 a frame push at capacity remains Rejected(error4); Candidate B new node/environment/helper-scratch/serialization capacity outcomes are named Exhausted(capacityKind). AdmissionRejected and tooling Unsupported remain outside the application outcome schema; their domain/refinement premises are pending.

expected.consumed work: reported (equals the fuel limit) and separate from any application return

unasserted: sherlock-k-a/1 frame-push-at-capacity Rejected(error4) (profile not selectable through the CLI)
